property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp/block, calling fallback with msg.value == 10 ether succeeds and advances pastBlockTime to block.timestamp+1 (the reference always accepts 10 ether payments and updates pastBlockTime; the mutant that requires 9 ether will reject 10 ether and thus can leave pastBlockTime unchanged for inputs where msg.value == 10 ether).
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when the fallback accepts calls and thus changing pastBlockTime updates observable via fallback.
